items.question: What is Vidyaan Academy?
items.answer: Vidyaan Academy (विद्यान अकादमी) is India's premier coaching academy offering expert-crafted courses for CBSE, ICSE, JEE, NEET, and Olympiad preparation. We combine innovative teaching methods with personalized learning paths, led by faculty from IITs, AIIMS, and top Indian universities.

items.question: How are classes conducted?
items.answer: We offer three modes: Online (live video sessions in Hindi and English), Offline (in-person at our Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, and Mumbai centers), and Hybrid (combination of both). All modes include access to recorded sessions and NCERT-aligned study materials.

items.question: What classes do you cover?
items.answer: We offer courses from Class 6 through Class 12, including specialized tracks for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET UG, Olympiads (INMO, INPhO, INOI), NTSE, and KVPY.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Simply book a free demo session through our website or call us at +91 80 4567 8901. Our counselors will assess your needs and recommend the best learning path for your board and target exam.

items.question: Can I take multiple courses simultaneously?
items.answer: Absolutely! Our Pro and Elite plans allow access to 3 or unlimited subjects respectively. We design schedules to avoid conflicts between JEE/NEET subjects.

items.question: Are study materials provided?
items.answer: Yes, all courses include comprehensive NCERT-aligned study materials - PDFs, video lessons, Daily Practice Problems (DPPs), and previous year papers for JEE, NEET, and board exams.

items.question: What if I miss a live class?
items.answer: All live sessions are recorded and available for playback. Starter plan gets 30-day access, Pro gets 90-day, and Elite gets lifetime access to recordings.

items.question: How are doubts resolved?
items.answer: Pro and Elite students have access to dedicated doubt-clearing sessions. You can also post questions on our student portal or WhatsApp groups for quick support.

items.question: What device do I need for online classes?
items.answer: Any device with a stable internet connection, camera, and microphone - laptop, tablet, or smartphone. We recommend a laptop for the best experience. Works well even on 4G connections.

items.question: Is there a mobile app?
items.answer: Our platform is fully responsive and works great on mobile browsers. A dedicated Android and iOS app is coming soon!

items.question: What if I face technical issues during a class?
items.answer: Our tech support team is available during all class hours via phone and WhatsApp. You can also access the recorded session at no extra cost if you face connectivity issues.
